questions.title: Range Validation Error Checker
questions.description:
Read an integer n. If 0 <= n <= 100 print OK, otherwise print ERROR. This models the most basic form of input validation.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single line: OK or ERROR.

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Scanf Return Value Inspector
questions.description:
Read two integers using a single scanf call. Inspect scanf's return value to determine whether both reads succeeded. Print READ_OK a b if both succeeded, otherwise READ_FAIL r where r is scanf's return value (0 if first token was non-numeric, 1 if only the first parsed).

Input Format:
Two space-separated tokens (may be non-numeric).

Output Format:
A single line: READ_OK a b on success, or READ_FAIL r on failure.

Constraints:
Tokens up to 32 chars

questions.title: Errno Setter for Negative Input
questions.description:
A library routine sets errno to 22 (EINVAL) when given a negative input. Read an integer n. If n < 0, set errno = 22; otherwise set errno = 0. Print the resulting errno value.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single integer: the errno value (22 if n < 0, 0 otherwise).

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Exit Code Simulator
questions.description:
A CLI tool returns 0 on success, 1 on failure, 2 on warning. Read an integer n: positive n maps to success (0), negative n to failure (1), zero to warning (2). Print the exit code.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single integer: the exit code (0, 1, or 2).

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Helper Returns Minus One on Error
questions.description:
A helper function returns -1 to signal an error. Read an integer n. If n < 0 the helper returns -1; otherwise it returns n*n. Print the helper's return value.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single integer: n*n if n >= 0, otherwise -1.

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Debug Range Assertion Printer
questions.description:
A debug build prints a trace message based on whether an input is in range. Read an integer n. If n > 100 print DEBUG: out_of_range; otherwise print DEBUG: ok.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single line: DEBUG: out_of_range or DEBUG: ok.

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: ATM Withdrawal Validator
questions.description:
An ATM dispenses cash only if the requested amount is positive and does not exceed the account balance. Read balance and amount. If amount <= 0 print INVALID_AMOUNT. Else if amount > balance print INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS. Otherwise print OK new_balance where new_balance = balance - amount.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers: balance and amount.

Output Format:
A single line: INVALID_AMOUNT, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, or OK new_balance.

Constraints:
0 <= balance <= 100000, -1000 <= amount <= 100000

questions.title: Temperature Sensor Fault Detector
questions.description:
An industrial temperature sensor reports values in Celsius. Readings below -50 or above 150 indicate a sensor fault. Read a temperature and print OK temp if in range, otherwise SENSOR_FAULT.

Input Format:
A single integer temperature.

Output Format:
A single line: OK temp or SENSOR_FAULT.

Constraints:
-200 <= temp <= 200

questions.title: Login Lockout After Attempts
questions.description:
A login system locks the account after 3 failed attempts. Read the number of failed attempts n. If n >= 3 print LOCKED; otherwise print ALLOWED attempts_left where attempts_left = 3 - n.

Input Format:
A single integer n (failed attempts so far).

Output Format:
A single line: LOCKED or ALLOWED attempts_left.

Constraints:
0 <= n <= 10

questions.title: Database Lookup Not Found Indicator
questions.description:
A database lookup returns a record id or signals NOT FOUND by setting errno to 2 (ENOENT). Read a record id. If the id is 0 the lookup fails: set errno = 2 and print the errno value. Otherwise print FOUND id.

Input Format:
A single integer id.

Output Format:
A single line: FOUND id on success, or the errno value (2) on not-found.

Constraints:
-1000 <= id <= 1000

questions.title: Errno and Strerror Range Reporter
questions.description:
A configuration tool reads a temperature setting and validates it against the operating range [-40, 85]. If out of range, set errno = EDOM (33), log the strerror message to stderr, and print ERROR_CODE errno_value to stdout. Otherwise print OK temp. Use strerror to format the stderr log; do not use perror or assert.

Input Format:
A single integer temperature.

Output Format:
A single line: OK temp, or ERROR_CODE errno_value.

Constraints:
-200 <= temp <= 200

questions.title: Strerror Lookup Table
questions.description:
A crash-log analyzer reads an errno code and prints the corresponding message using strerror. Read an errno code (a small non-negative integer) and print "code: message" where message is strerror(code). Do not use perror or switch-case for the mapping.

Input Format:
A single integer errno code.

Output Format:
A single line: code: message.

Constraints:
errno code in {0, 1, 2, 13, 22}

questions.title: Exit Code Constant Validator
questions.description:
A validator function returns EXIT_SUCCESS (0) when input is in [0, 100] and EXIT_FAILURE (1) otherwise. Read n. Call the validator and print the returned code. Do not use goto or abort.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single integer: 0 (success) or 1 (failure).

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Error Propagation Across Helpers
questions.description:
A two-layer helper chain returns -1 to signal errors and sets errno. helper2 returns n*n if n >= 0 (else sets errno=EINVAL and returns -1). helper1 propagates the -1. Read n, call helper1, and print OK result on success or ERROR -1 on failure (errno is also set). Do not use goto or abort.

Input Format:
A single integer n.

Output Format:
A single line: OK result, or ERROR -1.

Constraints:
-1000 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Multi-Field Validation with Errno
questions.description:
A form validator checks three fields: age (0-120), score (0-100), grade (1-5). Read age score grade. If any field is out of range, set errno=EINVAL and print INVALID field_name errno_value for the FIRST failing field. Otherwise print ALL_OK. Do not use goto or abort.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers: age, score, grade.

Output Format:
A single line: ALL_OK, or INVALID field_name errno_value.

Constraints:
-100 <= age, score, grade <= 200

questions.title: Simulated File Open with Strerror
questions.description:
A file manager simulates opening a file. Read a filename. If the name starts with "bad_", the open fails: set errno = ENOENT, log strerror(errno) to stderr, and print OPEN_FAILED errno_value to stdout. Otherwise print OPEN_OK. Do NOT actually call fopen, and do not use assert.

Input Format:
A single filename token.

Output Format:
A single line: OPEN_OK or OPEN_FAILED errno_value.

Constraints:
Filename length 1 to 64 chars

questions.title: Three-Level Errno Propagation
questions.description:
A 3-layer validation pipeline checks inputs a, b, c in order: layer 1 (a >= 0 → errno=EINVAL=22 on failure), layer 2 (b >= 0 → errno=ERANGE=34 on failure), layer 3 (c >= 0 → errno=EDOM=33 on failure). Read a b c. If any layer fails, print L<level>_ERROR errno_value for the first failing layer. Otherwise print SUCCESS sum where sum = a + b + c. Do not use goto or abort.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers a, b, c.

Output Format:
A single line: SUCCESS sum, or L<level>_ERROR errno_value.

Constraints:
-1000 <= a, b, c <= 1000

questions.title: Opcode Validator with Range Errors
questions.description:
A calculator CLI takes an opcode (1-5) and a value. Opcode 1 doubles, 2 triples, 3 squares, 4 negates, 5 zeroes. If the opcode is out of [1,5], set errno=EINVAL (22) and print OP_ERR errno_value. If the result exceeds [-1000, 1000], set errno=ERANGE (34) and print RANGE_ERR errno_value. Otherwise print OK result. Do not use goto or abort.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers: opcode and value.

Output Format:
A single line: OK result, OP_ERR errno_value, or RANGE_ERR errno_value.

Constraints:
-1000 <= value <= 1000, opcode in [-1, 10]

questions.title: Defensive Date Parser with Errno
questions.description:
A date parser reads a date in YYYY-MM-DD format and validates: year in [1900, 2100], month in [1, 12], day in [1, 31]. If any field is invalid, set errno=EINVAL (22) and print INVALID field_index errno_value where field_index is 1 (year), 2 (month), or 3 (day) for the FIRST failing field. If sscanf fails to parse 3 integers, print INVALID 0 0. Otherwise print VALID. Do not use goto or abort.

Input Format:
A single line in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Output Format:
A single line: VALID, INVALID 0 0, or INVALID field_index errno_value.

Constraints:
Year in [1000, 9999] (parsed as int)

questions.title: Retry Loop with EAGAIN Errno
questions.description:
An I/O client retries a failing operation up to 3 times. The operation succeeds on try N where N = (op_id % 4). If op_id % 4 == 0, it never succeeds within 3 tries. Read op_id. Simulate the retries: print OK try_num if the operation succeeded on try try_num, or set errno=EAGAIN (11) and print FAILED errno_value if all 3 tries failed. Use a for loop for the retry. Do not use goto, while, or assert.

Input Format:
A single integer op_id.

Output Format:
A single line: OK try_num, or FAILED errno_value.

Constraints:
1 <= op_id <= 100
